index.html.text: In the base case, displaced pump revenue reaches $1.4B a year by 2040. Held at today's market shares, that equals 20.9% of current revenue at each pump pure-play (Insulet, Tandem, Beta Bionics, MiniMed), more than the 10.6% at Dexcom. programs/sanofi-teplizumab/index.html.heading: Teplizumab (Tzield; Teizeild in EU)

programs/sanofi-teplizumab/index.html.text: FDA-approved (Nov 2022) to delay stage 3 T1D in stage 2 patients age 8+, based on TN-10 (median delay of about 2 years). EU approval came in Jan 2026. On Jun 12, 2026 the FDA granted accelerated approval to slow the decline of insulin production in children age 8–17 recently diagnosed with stage 3 T1D. That approval rests on a C-peptide surrogate endpoint, and a post-approval study must confirm clinical benefit. In the earlier PROTECT Phase 3 (new-onset), teplizumab met its C-peptide primary endpoint but did not separate on clinical secondary endpoints. A new Phase 3 (βETA PRESERVE, age 1–25) is enrolling.
programs/sanofi-teplizumab/index.html.heading: Summary

programs/sanofi-teplizumab/index.html.text: It's the only approved disease-modifying T1D drug, and now it's approved both before and just after diagnosis. It slows the disease rather than curing it, and the new-onset label is accelerated on a surrogate endpoint. If the confirmatory study fails, the FDA can withdraw it.

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: Why GLP-1s don't have a type 1 diabetes label yet

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: Of the 7 GLP-1-class brands checked against current FDA labels, 0 are indicated for type 1 diabetes.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: Key points

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: The last large attempt, Novo Nordisk's liraglutide ADJUNCT program (1,398 + 835 patients), found small HbA1c benefits and more symptomatic hypoglycemia and ketosis. No T1D label followed.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: Key points

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: Newer data are better on weight and insulin dose but small: 24 patients for 12 weeks (tirzepatide) and 72 for 26 weeks (semaglutide).
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: Key points

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: Lilly's SURPASS-T1D-1 and -2 (905 and 465 patients) are the first industry-sponsored Phase 3s of a GLP-1-class drug in T1D since ADJUNCT. The registry estimates primary completion in Nov 2026. Safety, not weight loss, is the bar.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: Key points

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: GLP-1-class drugs such as semaglutide and tirzepatide are approved for type 2 diabetes and weight management, and some people with type 1 diabetes already take them off-label to lose weight and cut insulin doses. Yet none of the 7 brands this site checks every day (Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound, Victoza, Trulicity, Rybelsus) carries a type 1 indication.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: Key points

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: In 2016 Novo Nordisk reported two Phase 3 trials of liraglutide added to insulin in type 1 diabetes. ADJUNCT ONE enrolled 1,398 patients for 52 weeks; ADJUNCT TWO enrolled 835.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: The trial that set the bar
The trial that set the bar
The trial that set the bar

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: Glycemic benefit was modest, reported in the abstracts as small HbA1c reductions versus placebo (this site still flags that summary range for re-checking against the dose-specific tables). At the highest dose, symptomatic hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia with ketosis rose. For regulators, a drug that adds ketosis risk in a population already exposed to diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) needs a large benefit to justify it. Liraglutide did not show one, and no T1D label followed.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: The trial that set the bar

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: Two things have changed: the drugs under study are newer, and the outcomes people care about have shifted from HbA1c alone to weight, time in range and insulin dose.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: What is different now

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: An independent Phase 2 in 24 adults with T1D and obesity reported −8.7 kg body weight and −35.1% total daily insulin versus placebo over 12 weeks, with a borderline HbA1c difference (−0.4 points, P = 0.05) and no severe hypoglycemia or DKA reported.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: What is different now

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: ADJUST-T1D randomized 72 adults on automated insulin delivery. After 26 weeks, 36% on semaglutide versus 0% on placebo met a composite of time in range above 70%, time below range under 4% and at least 5% weight loss; time in range rose 8.8 points. There were two severe hypoglycemia events in each arm and no DKA.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: What is different now

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: Lilly is now running SURPASS-T1D-1 (NCT06914895, 905 patients, registry status: active, not recruiting) and SURPASS-T1D-2 (NCT06962280, 465 patients), the first industry-sponsored Phase 3 program of a GLP-1-class drug in type 1 diabetes since ADJUNCT.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: The path to a label

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: The registry estimates primary completion for both in Nov 2026. That is when the last patient finishes the primary endpoint, not when results are published; toplines usually follow months later. Novo Nordisk has not announced a semaglutide T1D registration program; the semaglutide trials tracked here are academic.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: The path to a label

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: The question for a filing is whether DKA and severe hypoglycemia stay flat with hundreds of patients over a longer period. Continuous ketone monitoring could help manage that risk: Abbott's FreeStyle Libre Duo, the first integrated glucose-ketone sensor, received FDA De Novo authorization in August 2026.
research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.heading: The path to a label

research/glp1s-and-the-t1d-label/index.h.text: A T1D label would mostly change who pays, not who uses: off-label use already exists. For Lilly the T1D population is small next to type 2 diabetes and obesity. The more interesting read-across is to insulin pump and AID makers: if patients need around a third less insulin, pump volumes don't change but insulin consumption does. That would matter to insulin sellers more than to device makers.

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: The cure race in one chart

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: 15 active cure programs are tracked. 8 have advanced further than their evidence has read out; 7 have evidence that matches their stage.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Key points

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: The immune-evasive approach, the version of a cure that needs no immunosuppression, has at best Phase 1 evidence, from a single patient.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Key points

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: 3 programs have been discontinued, including the best-funded encapsulation effort.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Key points

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: Headlines about a type 1 diabetes cure tend to quote a program's stage: "Phase 3", "in the clinic", "IND cleared". Stage measures how far a sponsor has pushed. It says little about what has been shown. This site therefore grades every program twice:
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Key points

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: Figure 1. Active cure programs by stage reached (columns) and evidence read out (rows)
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Key points

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: Source: Tracking the Cure curated records, verified against the cited primary sources; registry data from ClinicalTrials.gov, Oct 26, 2026. Grey cells are impossible (evidence cannot exceed stage). Discontinued programs are excluded and listed below.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Key points

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: 7 of 15 active programs sit on it, but 2 of those are preclinical, where stage and evidence match only because there is no human data yet. The clinical programs with evidence that matches their stage are
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Reading the chart

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: (Phase 2). The approved ones show the limits of today's options. Lantidra uses deceased-donor islets, so supply is capped, and it needs chronic immunosuppression. Teplizumab delays or slows the disease; it does not restore insulin production.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Reading the chart

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: Vertex's zimislecel is at Phase 3 stage with Phase 2-grade evidence: in the NEJM report, 10 of 12 full-dose participants were insulin-independent at one year.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Reading the chart

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: Immune-evasive (hypoimmune) cells are the version that would need no immunosuppression. The best evidence is Sana's UP421: surviving, insulin-producing cells without immunosuppression in a single patient, at a dose too low to replace insulin.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Reading the chart

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: Sana's scalable successor, SC451, has not dosed a patient. Vertex's VX-017 has an IND cleared and no human data.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: Reading the chart

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: 3 programs are discontinued and kept on record:
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: What has dropped out

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: (Diamyd Medical). Vertex's VX-264, which put stem-cell islets inside a protective device, was safe but did not produce enough C-peptide.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: What has dropped out

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: Diamyd's Phase 3 stopped for futility. Each one removes a shot on goal, which is why the count of active programs matters less than where they sit on the chart.
research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.heading: What has dropped out

research/the-cure-race-in-one-chart/inde.text: For the Cure Impact Model, this argues for treating near-term approvals as the immunosuppression-required case: real, but narrow. The scenarios in which a cure displaces meaningful device and insulin revenue all depend on immune-evasive programs moving up the chart, and the best of them currently has Phase 1 evidence.

research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.heading: What a functional cure means for pump makers

research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.text: Pumps are the most exposed device category: the model assumes 85% of pump revenue is T1D-driven, against 40% for CGM, and a cured patient no longer needs a pump at all.
research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.heading: Key points

research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.text: Base case: displacement equal to 5.6% of a pump pure-play's current revenue by 2035 and 20.9% by 2040, versus 10.6% for Dexcom in 2040.
research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.heading: Key points

research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.text: The range is wide: 3.5% in the immunosuppression-required case and 94.9% in the bull case.
research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.heading: Key points

research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.text: Displacement begins only in 2031 in the base case (2029 in the bull case). Before then, the risk is to valuation multiples, not to reported revenue.
research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.heading: Key points

research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.text: For each company, displaced revenue = current trailing-twelve-month revenue × its share of revenue in each modelled market × that market's growth × the T1D share of the market × the share of T1D patients cured (reduced for CGM by the share of cured patients assumed to keep a sensor). research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.text: 1. Exposure, not size, drives the ranking.
research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.heading: Three observations

research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.text: Abbott's Diabetes Care business (≈$8.0B in FY2025) is bigger than any pump maker, but it is about 18% of Abbott's sales, and CGM is partly protected by type 2, over-the-counter use and post-cure monitoring. A pump pure-play has none of those cushions in the model. In the base case its 2040 hit is 2.0× Dexcom's as a share of current revenue.
research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.heading: Three observations

research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.text: 2. Capacity sets the pace.
research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.heading: Three observations

research/what-a-cure-means-for-pump-make.text: The base case caps treatment at 40,000 patients a year. With about 9.5 million people living with T1D, even a perfect product cures only 4.1% of them by 2040. bear.thesis: Immune-evasive cells slip, manufacturing stays scarce, and payers restrict access.

base.label: Base: immune-evasive cells work
base.thesis: A no-immunosuppression product is approved early next decade and adoption is capacity-limited.

bull.label: Bull: fast, broad adoption
bull.thesis: Fast approval, scaled manufacturing, and broad patient willingness.

immuno.label: Immunosuppression required
immuno.thesis: Only today's approach reaches market: cells plus lifelong immunosuppression, for the sickest patients.
